items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They sponsored a lot of clinics that I did, too... I played LeBlanc for many years

ctx.x: So one thing that we haven’t really covered is your instruments and you’ve changed instruments a little bit over the years but you said not very much.

No, when I consider compared to other clarinetists, I stayed with the same instrument for many years, through the years. For instance, the first actual decent clarinet I played on was a Selmer and I kind of oscillated between that and Buffet for some years. And I got a hold of a, mainly because of Artie Shaw again, a BT—Balanced Tone Selmer—and I used that for many years. And then I did some clinic and ran into Vito Pascucci; Vito Pascucci brought the LeBlanc clarinet to the United State from France. There’s an…
You know what I didn’t ask you about was your first clarinet.
